_comment: Per-site strategies, as data. start (see start.ts): the control that starts a player kept behind a cover, and the URL of the frame that plays once started. nav (see nav.ts): where the page keeps its episode list — items, label, current — or its own next/prev buttons. fullscreenKey is the site's own keyboard shortcut, sent as a real key event through the debugger; seekApi names a page-world seek for players that break when currentTime is written. keys lists the key combinations with a modifier that the site binds itself (the skip panel warns when one is chosen; bare keys never conflict, since the panel only answers modifier combinations). Leaving fullscreen needs no recipe: document.exitFullscreen() works everywhere.
